title: Implement the bounded submission supervisor adapter
goal: Adapt qualified existing comparator interfaces under a small trusted supervisor; no new theorem-comparison engine or claim service.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen source and policy are reconstructed independently; candidate PR paths map to a separate generated submission workspace.
Untrusted elaboration has no credentials/network/shared writable cache; all descendants terminate before outputs are sealed.
A separate verifier inspects bounded sealed artifacts and emits source-bound stage evidence with PASS/REJECT/INFRA.
Local positive/negative/fault tests and independent code review establish the supervisor boundary; no formal self-certification is asserted.
human_review: Independent bootstrap/boundary review and applicable empirical checks; mathematical claims need qualified packet gates
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Project source and concrete declarations are not yet bootstrapped; maintainer must instantiate and freeze this template before any live claim.
